title: Graphene Oxide Membrane for Solar-Driven Desalination
abstract: A desalination system with stacked GO membrane (0.9nm spacing) integrated with solar thermal collector achieving 99.5% salt rejection at 50 L/m2/hour.
claims: GO membrane with 50-200 layers, interlayer spacing 0.9 +/- 0.05 nm by Ca2+ crosslinking.
Solar thermal pre-heating achieving feed temperatures 60-80C.
Fabrication by vacuum filtration followed by Ca2+ crosslinking bath.
problem_statement: RO requires 3-10 kWh/m3. Combining membrane selectivity with solar heat may reduce energy to <1 kWh/m3.
